```{r}
# | echo: true
library(purrr)

lst_holidays <-
  list(
    "Christmas" = TRUE,
    "Halloween" = FALSE,
    "My Birthday" = TRUE,
    "Thanksgiving" = FALSE,
    "Valentine's Day" = FALSE
  )

lst_fav_holiday <- imap(
  lst_holidays,
  ~ paste(.y, ifelse(.x, "is", "is not"), "my favorite")
)

lst_fav_holiday
```

```{python}
# | echo: true

lst_holidays = [
    ("Christmas", True),
    ("Halloween", False),
    ("My Birthday", True),
    ("Thanksgiving", False),
    ("Valentine's Day", False),
]

lst_fav_holidays = [
    f"{holiday} is {'my favorite' if is_favorite else 'not my favorite'}."
    for holiday, is_favorite in lst_holidays
]

lst_fav_holidays
```
